SELECT strftime('%Y', t1.Date) AS Year, SUM(t1.Amount) AS TotalConsumption
FROM transactions_1k t1
JOIN customers t2 ON t1.CustomerID = t2.CustomerID
WHERE t2.Currency = 'CZK'
GROUP BY strftime('%Y', t1.Date)
ORDER BY TotalConsumption DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS TransactionCount
FROM transactions_1k t
INNER JOIN gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
WHERE g.Country = 'CZE' AND t.Date > '2012-01-01';

SELECT 
    (SUM(CASE WHEN c.Currency = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS PercentageOfEUR
FROM 
    transactions_1k t
JOIN 
    customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE 
    t.Date = '2012-08-25';

SELECT e.event_name
FROM event e
JOIN attendance a ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name
HAVING COUNT(a.link_to_member) > 20
AND e.notes NOT LIKE '%fundraiser%';

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN a.link_to_event IS NOT NULL THEN 'Yes' 
        ELSE 'No' 
    END AS attended
FROM 
    member m
JOIN 
    attendance a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member
JOIN 
    event e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE 
    m.first_name = 'Maya' 
    AND m.last_name = 'Mclean' 
    AND e.event_name = 'Women''s Soccer';

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS InPatientCount,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS OutPatientCount,
    CAST((SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS REAL) * 100 / 
    (SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS Deviation
FROM Patient
WHERE Admission != '' AND Admission != '-' AND SEX = 'M';

SELECT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
INNER JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE E.Thrombosis = 2;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) AS Underage_Patients
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE (strftime('%Y', E.`Examination Date`) - strftime('%Y', P.Birthday)) < 18
AND E.`Examination Date` BETWEEN '1990-01-01' AND '1993-12-31';

SELECT 
  (MAX(T2.`T-CHO`) - MIN(T2.`T-CHO`)) / MAX(T2.`T-CHO`) * 100 AS "Total Cholesterol Decrease Rate"
FROM 
  Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN 
  Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE 
  T1.Birthday = '1959-02-18'
  AND T2.Date BETWEEN '1981-11-01' AND '1981-12-31';

SELECT P.ID 
FROM Patient P 
INNER JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID 
WHERE P.Admission = '-' 
  AND L.Date LIKE '1991-10%' 
  AND L.`T-BIL` < 2.0;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M' AND L.GPT > 60;

SELECT P.SEX
FROM Patient P
INNER JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.`T-BIL` >= 2.0 AND P.SEX <> ''
GROUP BY P.SEX;

SELECT 
    T2.team_short_name AS away_team, 
    COUNT(*) AS wins
FROM 
    `Match` M
INNER JOIN 
    League L ON M.league_id = L.id
INNER JOIN 
    Team T2 ON M.away_team_api_id = T2.team_api_id
INNER JOIN 
    Country C ON L.country_id = C.id
WHERE 
    C.name = 'Scotland' 
    AND L.name = 'Scotland Premier League' 
    AND M.season = '2010'
    AND M.away_team_goal > M.home_team_goal
GROUP BY 
    T2.team_short_name
ORDER BY 
    wins DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
  (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', P.birthday)) AS age
FROM 
  Player P 
INNER JOIN 
  Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE 
  PA.sprint_speed >= 97 
  AND PA.date BETWEEN '2013-01-01' AND '2015-12-31';

SELECT AVG(M.home_team_goal) AS Average_Home_Goals
FROM `Match` M
JOIN Country C ON M.country_id = C.id
WHERE M.season = '2010/2011' AND C.name = 'Poland';

SELECT P.player_name
FROM Player P
INNER JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE PA.volleys > 70 AND PA.dribbling > 70;

SELECT P.player_name
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE PA.date = '2016/6/23' AND PA.overall_rating = 77
ORDER BY P.birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM Player_Attributes 
WHERE crossing = (SELECT MAX(crossing) FROM Player_Attributes) 
  AND preferred_foot = 'left' 
  AND attacking_work_rate <> 'None';

SELECT T2.lat, T2.lng
FROM races AS T1
INNER JOIN circuits AS T2 ON T1.circuitId = T2.circuitId
WHERE T1.name = 'Australian Grand Prix';

SELECT d.code
FROM drivers d
INNER JOIN qualifying q ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE q.raceId = 45 AND q.q3 = '0:01:33';

SELECT d.forename, d.surname
FROM drivers d
JOIN results r ON d.driverId = r.driverId
WHERE r.raceId = 872
ORDER BY d.dob DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
  d.forename, 
  d.surname, 
  SUM(ds.points) AS total_points
FROM 
  drivers d
  INNER JOIN driverStandings ds ON d.driverId = ds.driverId
GROUP BY 
  d.driverId
ORDER BY 
  total_points DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(lt.time) AS average_lap_time
FROM drivers d
INNER JOIN lapTimes lt ON d.driverId = lt.driverId
INNER JOIN races r ON lt.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE d.driverRef = 'lewis' AND r.name = 'Malaysian Grand Prix';

SELECT 
  T3.raceId AS race_id,
  T3.points AS points_scored
FROM 
  drivers AS T1
  INNER JOIN driverStandings AS T3 ON T1.driverId = T3.driverId
WHERE 
  T1.forename = 'Lewis' AND T1.surname = 'Hamilton'
ORDER BY 
  T3.raceId ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    MAX(r.fastestLapSpeed) AS fastest_lap_speed
FROM results r
INNER JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
WHERE ra.name = 'Spanish Grand Prix' AND ra.year = 2009;

SELECT 
  (
    (SELECT fastestLapTime FROM results WHERE raceId = (SELECT raceId FROM races WHERE name = 'Australian Grand Prix' AND year = 2008) AND driverId = (SELECT driverId FROM driverStandings WHERE raceId = (SELECT raceId FROM races WHERE name = 'Australian Grand Prix' AND year = 2008) ORDER BY points DESC LIMIT 1)) 
    - 
    (SELECT fastestLapTime FROM results WHERE raceId = (SELECT raceId FROM races WHERE name = 'Australian Grand Prix' AND year = 2008) AND position = (SELECT MAX(position) FROM results WHERE raceId = (SELECT raceId FROM races WHERE name = 'Australian Grand Prix' AND year = 2008)))
  ) * 100.0 / 
  (SELECT fastestLapTime FROM results WHERE raceId = (SELECT raceId FROM races WHERE name = 'Australian Grand Prix' AND year = 2008) AND position = (SELECT MAX(position) FROM results WHERE raceId = (SELECT raceId FROM races WHERE name = 'Australian Grand Prix' AND year = 2008))) AS percentage_difference

SELECT 
    (SUM(CASE WHEN r.position > 0 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*)) * 100 AS race_completion_percentage
FROM 
    drivers d
JOIN 
    results r ON d.driverId = r.driverId
JOIN 
    races rc ON r.raceId = rc.raceId
WHERE 
    d.nationality = 'Japanese' AND rc.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2009;

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN d.dob < '1985-01-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM drivers d
JOIN lapTimes l ON d.driverId = l.driverId
JOIN races r ON l.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE r.date BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2005-12-31'
  AND l.lap > 50;

SELECT d.driverId, d.driverId AS "Driver ID", d.driverId AS "Driver ID"
FROM lapTimes lt
JOIN drivers d ON lt.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE lt.time = (
    SELECT MIN(time) FROM lapTimes
)
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
INNER JOIN colour c_eye ON s.eye_colour_id = c_eye.id
INNER JOIN colour c_hair ON s.hair_colour_id = c_hair.id
WHERE c_eye.colour = 'Blue' AND c_hair.colour = 'Blonde';

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
INNER JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
INNER JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
INNER JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND sp.power_name = 'Super Strength';

SELECT r.race
FROM superhero s
INNER JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Copycat';

SELECT s.publisher_id
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Star Trek';

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.hair_colour_id = c.id
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE s.height_cm = 185 AND r.race = 'Human';

SELECT 
    colour_eye.colour AS eye_colour, 
    colour_hair.colour AS hair_colour, 
    colour_skin.colour AS skin_colour
FROM 
    superhero
INNER JOIN 
    colour AS colour_eye ON superhero.eye_colour_id = colour_eye.id
INNER JOIN 
    colour AS colour_hair ON superhero.hair_colour_id = colour_hair.id
INNER JOIN 
    colour AS colour_skin ON superhero.skin_colour_id = colour_skin.id
INNER JOIN 
    gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
WHERE 
    gender.gender = 'Female';

SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS percentage_marvel
FROM 
    superhero s
JOIN 
    hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN 
    publisher p ON s.id = p.id
WHERE 
    ha.attribute_id = 1 AND ha.attribute_value = 'Female';

SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN c.colour = 'Blue' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM 
    superhero s
JOIN 
    colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id;

SELECT 
  DisplayName
FROM 
  users
WHERE 
  DisplayName IN ('Harlan', 'Jarrod Dixon')
ORDER BY 
  Reputation DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT p.FavoriteCount
FROM comments c
JOIN posts p ON c.PostId = p.Id
WHERE c.UserId = 3025 AND c.CreationDate = '2014-04-23 20:29:39';

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM comments c
JOIN users u ON c.UserId = u.Id
WHERE c.Text = 'thank you user93!';

SELECT 
    ((SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', Date) = '2011' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - 
      SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', Date) = '2010' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 / 
     SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', Date) = '2010' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS PercentageDifference
FROM 
    badges;

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM users u
JOIN badges b ON u.Id = b.UserId
WHERE b.Name = 'Autobiographer'
ORDER BY b.Date ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT p.Id, p.Title
FROM posts p
JOIN postHistory ph ON p.Id = ph.PostId
WHERE ph.UserDisplayName = 'Harvey Motulsky'
ORDER BY p.ViewCount DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.Reputation > 1000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.Id) AS Percentage
FROM 
  posts T1
INNER JOIN 
  users T2 ON T1.OwnerUserId = T2.Id
WHERE 
  STRFTIME('%Y', T1.CreaionDate) = '2011';

SELECT u.Reputation, u.UpVotes
FROM users u
INNER JOIN comments c ON u.Id = c.UserId
WHERE c.Text = 'fine, you win :)';

SELECT c.id, c.artist 
FROM cards c 
INNER JOIN legalities l ON c.uuid = l.uuid 
WHERE c.power IS NULL AND l.format = 'Commander' AND l.status = 'Legal';

SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN f.language = 'French' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(c.uuid) AS percentage
FROM 
    cards c
JOIN 
    foreign_data f ON c.uuid = f.multiverseid
WHERE 
    c.isStorySpotlight = 1;

SELECT DISTINCT c.types
FROM cards c
JOIN foreign_data fd ON c.uuid = fd.uuid
WHERE fd.language = 'de';

SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN layout != 'normal' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(*) AS proportion
FROM 
    cards;

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN (SELECT convertedManaCost FROM cards WHERE name = 'Serra Angel') > 
             (SELECT convertedManaCost FROM cards WHERE name = 'Shrine Keeper') 
        THEN 'Serra Angel'
        ELSE 'Shrine Keeper'
    END AS card_with_higher_converted_cost;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM cards 
INNER JOIN sets ON cards.setCode = sets.code 
WHERE sets.name = 'Hauptset Zehnte Edition' 
AND cards.artist = 'Adam Rex';

SELECT fd.flavorText
FROM cards c
INNER JOIN foreign_data fd ON c.uuid = fd.uuid
WHERE c.name = 'Ancestor''s Chosen' AND fd.language = 'Italian';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
INNER JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+' AND b.bond_type = 'Triple';

SELECT 
  ROUND(
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'H' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(a.atom_id), 
    4
  ) AS hydrogen_percentage
FROM 
  atom a
WHERE 
  a.molecule_id = 'TR206';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_bonds
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR009' AND a.atom_id = '12';

SELECT DISTINCT m.label
FROM molecule m
INNER JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id BETWEEN '21' AND '25';

SELECT COUNT(a.atom_id) AS total_atoms
FROM atom a
INNER JOIN bond b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = 'Triple' AND a.element IN ('p', 'br');

SELECT s.School, s.Street || ', ' || s.City || ', ' || s.State AS FullAddress
FROM schools s
INNER JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE ABS(f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > 30;

SELECT s.AdmFName1, s.AdmLName1, s.AdmFName2, s.AdmLName2, s.AdmFName3, s.AdmLName3
FROM satscores ss
INNER JOIN schools s ON ss.cds = s.CDSCode
ORDER BY ss.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
  T1.sname AS SchoolName, 
  AVG(T1.AvgScrWrite) AS AvgWriteScore
FROM 
  satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN 
  schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE 
  T2.AdmFName1 = 'Ricci' AND T2.AdmLName1 = 'Ulrich'
GROUP BY 
  T1.sname;
